releases.name: v0.2.0 — OpenCode V2 support
releases.body:
## v0.2.0 — OpenCode V2 support

The plugin now runs on the OpenCode V2 plugin API and produces its topic-structured compaction summary under V2's compaction pipeline.

### Added
- V2 entrypoint: `Plugin.define({ id, setup(ctx) })` with `ctx.session.hook("compaction", …)`.
- The plugin now **owns** the compaction when ≥2 topics are detected: it generates the summary itself (`ctx.generate.text`) and records it through the hook's `result`. The output is pure `# TOPIC n:` + `# STATE` — no native headings.
- Diagnostics: every plugin load and every compaction decision is appended to `~/.local/share/opencode/log/topic-compaction.log`.

### Changed
- Session messages are read from the V2 store via `ctx.session.context()` (the legacy `message`/`part` tables are empty under V2).
- Runtime layout is now a plugin **directory** (`.opencode/plugins/topic-compaction/` with `index.ts`), which V2 discovery requires. Loose `.ts` files beside the helpers are no longer loaded as separate (broken) plugins.
- Below two topics, or on any generation error or empty result, the hook sets nothing and OpenCode's native compaction runs untouched (fail-open).

### Fixed
- Compaction no longer fails with `Compaction summary did not match the required template`. V2 validates the model-generated summary against its own section headings, so the plugin generates and records the summary itself instead.

### Verified
- Real session with 59 user turns clustered into 10 topics → plugin-generated `# TOPIC 1…10` + `# STATE`, `status: completed`, no native headings.
- Single-context session (18 directories, one user turn) → 1 topic → clean native fallback.
- Typecheck and unit tests pass.
Initial version, not sure if I'll add anything after this
